title: Settings: other auth keys still show the manifest default, not the deployment declaration, when nothing is stored
body:
repo:objectstack#6 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjQkY5yXZrN9BEA3rEK

Filing gate: ③ follow-up of a delivery in review. PR #38180 (`Fixes #38098`) adds `SettingsService.registerDeclaredDefault` and registers declared defaults for three auth keys (`email_password_enabled`, `signup_enabled`, `require_email_verification`). Dev report 7234889808 and the contract review on #38180 note two gaps it leaves.

1. Other `auth.*` keys whose deployment declaration can differ from the manifest default (the rows of `AUTH_SETTING_RESTORE` in plugin-auth: `password_min_length`, `password_max_length`, `membership_policy`, `mfa_required`, session and lockout windows, rate limits) still resolve to the manifest default with nothing stored. Inferred from the same `bindAuthSettings` shape, not measured through a public entry point: measure each first, then register a declared default for each that differs (one formula per key on the new seam).
2. A `signup_enabled` stored on, on an SSO-only or cloud-managed runtime that forces sign-up off, shows on with no statement on the page (predates #38180; the live-status banner covers only `email_password_enabled`).

Prerequisite: PR #38180 merged.
Suggested-grade: p3 · completes a landed seam.
Dedupe: `registerDeclaredDefault`, `AUTH_SETTING_RESTORE manifest default`, `signup_enabled forced off banner` found only #38098 / #38180.
